title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
About LightSource
LightSource is building the next-generation operating system for Procurement. Sales has Salesforce. HR has Workday. Procurement is next. We build SaaS software that helps procurement leaders discover vendors, manage negotiations, and buy intelligently.
Our team is small but growing quickly, backed by top-tier investors and already winning enterprise customers. We're tackling a massive market filled with complex, high-impact problems. The team includes people who've helped build companies like Tesla, Waymo, McKinsey, and Google X. We hire exceptional people, move quickly, give direct feedback, expect excellence, and have a lot of fun doing it.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager — someone who can own how LightSource is understood in market and help build the PMM function from the ground up. This isn't a typical PMM role. You won't inherit someone else's positioning — you'll sharpen and own it. You'll work closely with product, sales, and leadership to craft messaging that lands with procurement and operations leaders, and produce the content that puts those ideas in front of the right people.
The right person will combine strategic depth with a writer's instincts and a builder's work ethic. You know how to market technical products to skeptical industrial buyers — and you've found a way to do it credibly. You will be the person who defines how LightSource is talked about, sold, and remembered.
This is a full-time, onsite role at our office in downtown San Francisco (off Market St, steps from BART and Caltrain.
Role & Responsibilities

- Own and continuously refine LightSource's positioning, messaging architecture, and ICP definition

- Develop buyer personas grounded in real customer and prospect research, win/loss interviews, sales call analysis, and market study

- Drive product launches end to end: messaging, internal enablement, external assets, and coordinated rollout with sales and demand gen

- Build and maintain a core sales enablement library: one-pagers, battle cards, objection handling guides, and ROI frameworks

- Own the content strategy and editorial calendar — set priorities, write or commission key pieces, and maintain quality across all formats

- Write thought leadership content (long-form, point of view, research-backed) that builds LightSource's credibility in supply chain and procurement circles

- Partner with demand gen on campaign messaging, AEO visibility, and analyst and press narratives

- Track competitive positioning and maintain clear, current battle cards

- Help hire and mentor future PMM and content hires as the team grows

About You
You're not looking to maintain a positioning doc someone else wrote — you want to own the narrative. You've done this for a technical product with a complex buying process and you know how to bring rigor and creativity to both. You're a strong writer who doesn't lose precision when translating capability into value. You thrive in environments where strategic thinking and getting your hands dirty are equally expected. You might be a great fit if you:

- Have 5–8 years in product marketing or content marketing at a B2B SaaS company

- Are a strong writer who can translate technical capabilities into business value without losing precision or credibility

- Have a track record of conducting and applying buyer research to improve messaging and win rates

- Have experience supporting enterprise or mid-market sales cycles with high-quality enablement materials

- Are comfortable leading cross-functional workstreams — you know how to align product, sales, and marketing without owning everything

- Thrive in fast-moving startup environments with high autonomy and high expectations

- Want to grow into leadership and help build a team over time

- Value direct feedback and continuous improvement

Comp & Benefits

- Top-of-market base compensation with meaningful early-employee equity

- Platinum-level healthcare, 100% covered for employees

- Dental and vision, 100% covered

- 401(k) program

- Unlimited vacation and sick days

- Free food (3 meals a day, if desired) in office locations

- Frequent team offsites, events, dinners, and weekend trips

Bonus Points

- Background in or deep familiarity with supply chain, procurement, or industrial operations

- Experience marketing AI or data intelligence products to non-technical buyers

- Analyst relations or media experience

- You can code in Rust (kidding... unless?)

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About the role
Supply chain is broken. It's the foundation of our entire economy, but it (barely) runs on a mix of home-brewed processes duct taped to some spreadsheets and emails.
Join as one of the founding members of the LightSource product management organization. As a product manager, you'll be the hub that drives cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, go-to-market, and stakeholders to build products.
This is a full-time, onsite role at our office in downtown San Francisco (off Market St, steps from BART and Caltrain

Responsibilities

- Discover, understand, and refine user requirements

- Define the product vision and the success criteria for projects

- Organize complex, multi-faceted, multi-stage initiatives that span multiple teams and multiple projects. Ensure that work is on track

- Collaborate with engineers, designers, and experts in the field of procurement and supply chain on frontier technologies

- Work with go-to-market stakeholders to communicate product capabilities and vision to prospects

- Gather user and prospect feedback and perform market research to guide product development

- Clearly communicate progress and strategy across the whole company

- Coordinate with marketers to ensure that customers are aware of and excited by launches

- Work directly with founders in a high-speed environment

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree (or relevant equivalent) in a STEM subject. Ideally computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics, applied sciences.

- 5+ years of experience in Product Management

- Experience managing a product through a full product lifecycle

- Understanding of compiling and analyzing large-scale complex data sets and using that to drive decision making

- Experience in clear communication of highly technical and complex information

The Team
We're a driven team, who've helped build some incredible companies (Tesla, Waymo, Google, Meta, Amazon, Dropbox, Airbnb and many more). And now we're tackling an exciting problem space ripe for disruption.
Our team is small, but our ambitions are big. So we only hire the absolute best and try to learn every day while having a lot of fun.

title: Software Engineering TLM
description:
About the role
Supply chain is broken. It's the foundation of our entire economy, but it (barely) runs on a mix of home-brewed processes duct-taped to some spreadsheets and emails.
As a Tech Lead Manager at LightSource, you'll be expected to wear many hats. You will be in charge of a team of senior engineers and responsible for your own work as an individual contributor.
As a manager, you'll be coordinating resources, driving planning and execution, and promoting technical excellence throughout the org.
This is a full-time, onsite role at our office in downtown San Francisco (off Market St, steps from BART and Caltrain

Responsibilities
Planning and Execution

- Ensure that work is aligned with business objectives and product goals

- Build execution plans meeting resource constraints

- Drive delivery of work against objectives

- Manage risks, problem-solve, and course correct as necessary. Resolve technical conflicts that arise

Technical Excellence

- Guide technical work through direct, hands-on, management as needed

- Adhere to and enforce team quality, security, and consistent development standards

- Assess technical output of the team against KPIs

- Maintain awareness of advancements in the domain and incorporate them into the team

Communication, Collaboration, and Culture

- Identify, report, and rectify any perceived problems or organizational risks

- Maintain and elevate the existing company culture across your team

People and Organization

- Create a psychologically safe environment and provide support and motivation to the team

- Proactively check in with team members to ensure that their performance is good and their needs are met

- Manage performance within the direct team and set a high-performance bar with guardrails

- Proactively resolve interpersonal conflicts within the team

Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in software development

- 3+ years of people management experience in a startup environment

- Track record of successfully shipping products

The Team
We're a driven team, who've helped build some incredible companies (Tesla, Waymo, Google, Meta, Amazon, Dropbox, Airbnb and many more). And now we're tackling an exciting problem space ripe for disruption.
Our team is small, but our ambitions are big. So we only hire the absolute best and try to learn every day while having a lot of fun.

title: Sr. Growth & Demand Generation Manager
description:
About LightSource
LightSource is building the next-generation operating system for Procurement. Sales has Salesforce. HR has Workday. Procurement is next. We build SaaS software that helps procurement leaders discover vendors, manage negotiations, and buy intelligently.
Our team is small but growing quickly, backed by top-tier investors and already winning enterprise customers. We're tackling a massive market filled with complex, high-impact problems. The team includes people who've helped build companies like Tesla, Waymo, McKinsey, and Google X. We hire exceptional people, move quickly, give direct feedback, expect excellence, and have a lot of fun doing it.

About the Role
We're looking for our first Growth & Demand Generation Manager — someone excited to help build the marketing function from the ground up. This isn't a typical demand gen role. You won't be handed a rigid playbook — you'll help write it. You'll work closely with leadership and our Account Executives to build the inbound and outbound marketing motion that fuels our next phase of growth.
The right person will combine analytical rigor, creative instincts, and a builder's mentality to drive pipeline from procurement leaders at some of the world's most interesting companies. You will be the architect of our demand engine and help set the foundation for how LightSource goes to market.
This is a full-time, onsite role at our office in downtown San Francisco (off Market St, steps from BART and Caltrain

Role & Responsibilities

- Build the demand generation playbook from scratch — AEO, paid, lifecycle campaigns, ABM programs, and the attribution stack that shows what's actually working

- Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation and be directly accountable for MQLs and sourced pipeline

- Partner closely with sales to define ICP tiers, score inbound leads, and design tight MQL-to-SQL handoffs

- Build and run account-based marketing campaigns targeting key verticals: manufacturing, industrials, and supply chain-heavy sectors

- Manage and optimize budget allocation across channels, continuously testing and cutting what doesn't perform

- Own HubSpot workflows, landing pages, and campaign operations end to end

- Coordinate with content and PMM to ensure campaigns are backed by strong messaging and relevant assets

- Help hire and mentor future marketing hires as the team grows

About You
You're not looking to maintain someone else's system — you want to build your own. You've been a top performer and want more ownership. You enjoy constructing demand engines from scratch and thrive in environments where initiative matters more than process. You're disciplined with metrics but lead with creativity. You might be a great fit if you:

- Have 5+ years of experience in demand gen or growth marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data-driven company

- Have a track record of running paid campaigns on LinkedIn and Google, including budget management and optimization

- Are comfortable with HubSpot — you know how to build workflows, not just use templates

- Have strong analytical instincts: you track CAC, MQL volume, and pipeline sourced, and can diagnose why numbers move

- Can write clear, direct copy when needed and brief agencies or contractors effectively

- Thrive in fast-moving startup environments with high autonomy and high expectations

- Want to grow into leadership and help build a team over time

- Value direct feedback and continuous improvement

Comp & Benefits

- Top-of-market base compensation with meaningful early-employee equity

- Platinum-level healthcare, 100% covered for employees

- Dental and vision, 100% covered

- 401(k) program

- Unlimited vacation and sick days

- Free food (3 meals a day, if desired) in office locations

- Frequent team offsites, events, dinners, and weekend trips

Bonus Points

- Prior experience in industrial tech, supply chain, or manufacturing SaaS

- Familiarity with ABM tools (6sense, Demandbase, or similar) and intent data platforms

- Experience building first-party audience strategies
